name: Conveyor Lanes
description: Some grid rows ride a conveyor. Every time you open a box, the entire lane shifts one slot — so each tap reshuffles which boxes you can reach.
howToPlay: The orange-tinted rows are conveyor lanes with arrows showing their direction. Walls below create narrow windows so only a few boxes are reachable at a time. Tap an open box: it spawns marbles and the lane shifts, exposing a different set of boxes. Plan your taps so every box eventually lines up with a window.
author: Claude prototype
